overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The chair did not reasonably anticipate the Annual Town Report draft 48 hours before the February 26 meeting, so the Board could take it up under the unanticipated-topics rule.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board discussed and voted on its Annual Town Report draft at a February 26 meeting although the chair reasonably anticipated the topic but it was missing from the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Chair did not reasonably anticipate discussing the draft report 48 hours in advance of the Board's February 26 meeting, the Board did not violate the law by discussing it at the meeting that evening, even though it was not included as a topic for discussion in the meeting notice.
